author: CBR
description:
Christopher Nolan’s *The Odyssey* is a visually stunning, emotionally grounded epic. Let’s break down what works, what struggles, and why it was worth the wait.

Let’s break down Nolan’s ambitious follow-up to Oppenheimer, led by Matt Damon as Odysseus, Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Tom Holland as Telemachus, and Robert Pattinson as the sinister Antinous. Discover how the story moves between brutal warfare, political conflict in Ithaca, mythological monsters, and Odysseus’ desperate journey home.

Check out why Damon delivers one of the strongest performances of his career, how Hathaway gives Penelope greater complexity, and why Pattinson’s “oily charm” makes Antinous such an effective villain. We also explore the terrifying Cyclops encounter, the horrors of Circe’s island, Ludwig Göransson’s overwhelming score, and the sound design that makes every stretch at sea feel dangerous.

The nonlinear structure occasionally makes the 172-minute story harder to follow, but those issues are minor
title: The Odyssey Review: The Wait Was Worth It
